Hymn 167: Come, Let Us Sing an Evening Hymn
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: Tracy Y. Cannon
Lyricist/Text Author: William W. Phelps
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 167 titled "Come, Let Us Sing an Evening Hymn" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Tracy Y. Cannon and the lyrics were written by William W. Phelps.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
